description:
From the fz-kdt.178 refutation (2026-09-03, 8de517a28). Three reader gaps in
drive_test.rs, all pre-existing (seated_arm_surfaces is older than 178):
(1) blind_escapes bails on `early.len() != late.len()` -- the census compares
subject MAPS, so a pair of arms that question DIFFERENT subject sets is
silently skipped, while production callsite_dispatch::covers (~:305) walks
every position of the full question vector and judges it. Any plan where two
arms ask about different numbers of subjects: the test reports nothing,
production seats it. (2) separated_somewhere iterates only the subjects
present in `early`; a separating subject present only in `late` is never
consulted (masked today by (1)'s length guard). (3) Site keys: `executable N`
and case/receive `e<N>` are positional indexes that renumber on unrelated
source edits (ratchet rows churn); `w<N>` (wrapper.identity) does not -- but
the canon dump (--dump backend=) renumbers wrappers canonically, so dump wN !=
census wN, and a reader following "w10, w11, w20" from the docs into a dump
lands on the wrong wrapper. FIX: the reader reads the plan's full question
vector per arm (positions, not subject maps) so it mirrors covers exactly and
no pair is skipped; separation is judged over the union of both arms'
positions; site keys are the STABLE identities (wrapper.identity, and an
executable's canonical key label instead of its index), and the docs name
wrappers by the identity the dump prints (or the dump prints the identity).
Measure how many pairs the length guard skipped on the 22 census fixtures
before/after.

comments.text: fz-kdt.179 landed (c3e27143d): member selection now runs the seat, but your two reader gaps are UNCHANGED and one is now the last census standing. INDISTINGUISHABLE_ARM_POPULATION (kept at 44 groups) still names CENSUS wrapper numbers, which differ from dump wN -- your dump-wN-vs-census-wN gap. And the static census reader's arm-pair skipping is retired for the SEAT census here but your description covers the reading logic that INDISTINGUISHABLE still uses. Re-measure against this base: the seat census is gone, so your scope narrows to INDISTINGUISHABLE's numbering and any reader the entry/case/receive censuses still use.

title: The static census reader skips arm pairs that ask different subject sets and consults separating subjects only on the earlier arm, where production covers walks the full position vector; and dump wrapper numbers differ from census wrapper numbers
